fee_note: Under SEBI's rules a share of profits is a portfolio manager's fee, and it must be measured from a high-water mark. A registered investment adviser may charge only a fixed fee or a fee on assets under advice. Altaha does the arithmetic; whether an arrangement is allowed depends on your registration.
